title: Normalized constructible tensor-completion presentation
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and a scheme $X$. Use modules over the completed integral coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] and their unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with the completed tensor and its good K-flat model [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. A tensor-completion presentation consists of an ordinary derived tensor bifunctor, its good-complex localization model, a natural cochain map from the ordinary total tensor to the completed tensor complex, and its descended derived comparison. Require all four equations: each quotient projection sends a homogeneous pure tensor to the tensor of the two quotient sections; every shifted mapping-cocone coordinate is zero; the cochain and derived maps agree through the two model isomorphisms; and on every pair of integral constructible inputs the ordinary tensor is derived complete and the comparison is invertible. This defines data and equations, without asserting existence.
